content.short: Fluid allows users to borrow against, rent out, license, collectively own and trade NFTs.
content.description: Fluid enables users to borrow against, rent out, license, collectively own, and trade NFTs, while supporting collaborative ownership and governance of NFT rights delegation, sales, licensing, and revenue models tied to fractionalized assets. The platform introduces a new primitive that unlocks NFT rights delegation, cross-protocol utility, NFT-owned assets, debts and revenue streams, and instant, open-ended loans. This approach broadens how communities manage and monetize NFT portfolios across ecosystems.
